actual_scope: Construct and independently check a pooled {0,2}/{0,1,2} correction on Y0/Y1/Y2, retaining the PR2504 late-exclusive branch, with an exact finite local bill. No full supplier or kappa claim.
scope_change_reason: Live overlap completes many original cut questions. PR2460 explicitly leaves cross-group mixing open; this changes its incidence-separation premise and tests one two-stage fanout, instead of repeating its separated rank floor or the PR2504 late acquisition.

stop_rule: Stop after one pooled word passes complete arbitrary-dirty-input, frame, literal preservation and local bill checks, or the smallest instance falsifies it. Do not claim global or unrestricted helper optimality.
